title: Persistent benchmark ledger, comparison UI (Compareboard), and anomaly triage workflow
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a persistent benchmark result store ("benchmark ledger"), a comparison-first UI (Compareboard) for token/sec and latency metrics, and a lightweight anomaly triage workflow integrated with alerts and runbooks. Goal: make regression detection actionable for engineers and PMs — surface p95 regressions, tokens/sec changes, and show diffs across model variants, quantization, and hardware. This ticket covers storage schema, ingest API, core UI screens, and the on-call triage playbook. Excludes long-term retention policy and cost-optimization gating (tracked in follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Store ingested benchmark runs with metadata: model, version, quant, hardware, input-profile, seed.
Expose API to query runs by time range and to compute baseline diffs (tokens/sec, p50, p95, error-rate).
Compareboard UI shows side-by-side run diffs, history sparkline, and highlights >10% p95 regressions and >15% tokens/sec drops.
On-alert flow creates a triage card that links to failed runs, replay harness command, and a GitHub issue template.
Automated regression detection flags are testable in staging with synthetic regressions.
tasks: Design storage schema (time-series + run metadata) and prototype insert API
Implement ingest worker that normalizes run output and writes to ledger (S3 + metadata DB)
Build Compareboard backend endpoints for run diffs and aggregate metrics
Ship MVP Compareboard frontend: run list, run detail, diff view, baseline selection
Add anomaly detector job (cron) that computes relative deltas and writes alerts to PagerDuty and Slack
Create on-call triage runbook and GitHub issue template
E2E test: synthetic regression job and verify alert -> triage -> regression bug flow

notes_decisions: Storage trade-off: start with S3 blobs + Postgres metadata. If aggregate query load grows, introduce Clickhouse/time-series store for aggregate views.
Baseline selection: heuristics prefer latest green run on the same model/quant/hardware; allow manual pinning in UI.
Anomaly rules: use percentile change + absolute delta thresholds to avoid noisy alerts on low-latency models.
Privacy: for Private deployments, ingest endpoint supports VPC-only delivery and S3 encryption with KMS key-id header.
triage_workflow: 1) Alert fires to #perf-alerts Slack + PagerDuty with run id and diff snapshot.
2) On-call loads Compareboard run detail and validates raw trace (link to S3) and replay command.
3) If reproducible, create ENG bug using template (auto-populated fields), tag responsible team and link PR.
4) If false-positive/noise, mark anomaly as "resolved" with reason and tweak detector thresholds or baseline selection.
5) Postmortem for any customer-impacting regression (>=high) and schedule rollback or mitigation.
anomaly_detection_spec: Daily cron job compares each new run against pinned baseline: compute relative delta for p95 and tokens/sec.
Thresholds: p95 increase > 10% AND absolute increase > 25ms -> P1 alert. tokens/sec drop > 15% -> P1 alert.
Suppression: ignore runs with sample size < 30 or error-rate > 2% (likely noisy).
Auto-create triangular ticket when both p95 and tokens/sec thresholds exceed limits.
Record anomaly fingerprints (model+version+seed+input-profile) to avoid duplicate alerts.
acceptance_notes: MVP: ingest + Compareboard + basic detector + runbook. Do not block on long-retention or advanced aggregation infra.
Follow-up tickets: retention policy, cost-based pruning, multi-model rollup views, advanced ML anomaly detector (ENG-9012).
